# SeedText

> SeedText is a free AI article draft studio: type a niche keyword, pick a
> content style (Informational deep-dive, Case Study, or Step-by-Step Guide),
> and a structured, publish-ready Markdown article streams into your workspace
> live. Free forever — no credits, no subscription.

SeedText is a web application at https://seedtext.app/

## Key facts

- Price: $0. Unlimited drafts within fair-use limits; no card or subscription required.
- Input: a niche target keyword and a content style.
- Output: structured Markdown — H1 hook, H2/H3 sections, bullet points, comparison table, conclusion.
- Streaming: drafts generate live, token by token, usually finishing in under a minute.
- Article frameworks: Informational deep-dives, results-first Case Studies, numbered Step-by-Step Guides.
- History: signed-in users keep every finished draft in the "Seed Vault" for later reading, copying, or reloading.
- Ownership: users own the drafts they generate and may edit, publish, and monetize them.
- Guest access: no account required to start; guests simply don't get draft history.

## Who it's for

Niche site publishers, affiliate bloggers, indie founders, and content teams
who need fast first drafts for long-tail keywords without paying per-word AI
pricing.

## How it works

1. Enter a niche keyword (for example "cold plunge recovery").
2. Choose a content style: Informational, Case Study, or Step-by-Step Guide.
3. Click Generate — the Markdown draft streams into the workspace live.
4. Copy the Markdown into any CMS, or sign in to keep it in your Seed Vault.
